classification_policy: Required is the minimal default matching denominator, not proof of candidate proficiency. Recommended and advanced are coaching context only. Languages are alternatives, not simultaneous requirements. Legacy role denominators are retained for score compatibility. No new weights.

roles.name: machine learning engineer
roles.rationale: Preserves the existing default denominator; this legacy profile is not a universal hiring standard.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain train/test separation and a simple model pipeline with guidance; no production platform ownership is assumed.
experience_expectations.fresher: Build a reproducible project pipeline, choose validation metrics and explain leakage prevention.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Debug training/serving mismatches, compare serving and data-processing trade-offs and justify measurements.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about deployment reliability, data/model drift, monitoring and operational recovery under stated constraints.

roles.name: data scientist
roles.rationale: Preserves the existing default denominator; this legacy profile is not a universal hiring standard.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain a data question, basic summary statistics and a train/test split using a small example.
experience_expectations.fresher: Justify preprocessing, validation and metrics for a documented project without causal overclaims.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Compare modeling and experiment alternatives, diagnose bias/leakage and communicate uncertainty.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about experimental validity, population shifts, product trade-offs and limits of causal interpretation.

roles.name: ai engineer
roles.rationale: Preserves the existing default denominator; this legacy profile is not a universal hiring standard.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain embeddings, API requests and why generated answers need verification using a small example.
experience_expectations.fresher: Build a bounded AI/RAG prototype, cite sources and test known failure cases.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Diagnose retrieval/generation failures, compare evaluation strategies and control permissions and costs.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about reliability, adversarial inputs, evaluation uncertainty, observability and safe operational recovery.

roles.name: python developer
roles.rationale: Preserves the existing default denominator; this legacy profile is not a universal hiring standard.

experience_expectations.internship: Trace collections, functions and exceptions in a small Python program with guidance.
experience_expectations.fresher: Build a tested small CLI or API, explain personal implementation choices and handle common failures.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Profile I/O and CPU bottlenecks, debug state sharing and choose appropriate concurrency mechanisms.
experience_expectations.experienced: Design maintainable interfaces and reliable deployment/diagnostic boundaries, with explicit compatibility trade-offs.

roles.name: software engineer
roles.rationale: Language-neutral programming and collaborative delivery baseline; choose a stack-specific JD when language proficiency is required.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain fundamentals and trace a small example with guidance; coursework is acceptable evidence context, not demonstrated professional experience.
experience_expectations.fresher: Implement and test a small feature; explain a personal project and its limitations.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Debug failures, compare practical alternatives and explain measured trade-offs in this role.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about architecture, reliability, security and operational trade-offs; state assumptions rather than relying on trivia.

roles.name: frontend developer
roles.rationale: Browser fundamentals, accessible interaction and testable delivery are the baseline; frameworks remain stack-specific recommendations.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain fundamentals and trace an accessible browser interaction with guidance; no production ownership is assumed.
experience_expectations.fresher: Build or explain an accessible browser interaction in a project, including basic tests and limitations.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Debug an accessible browser interaction under realistic constraints and compare practical alternatives using evidence.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about architecture, reliability, security and operational trade-offs around an accessible browser interaction; document assumptions and failure recovery.

roles.name: backend developer
roles.rationale: Focuses on API/data correctness and access boundaries; languages and database products are alternatives rather than simultaneous requirements.

experience_expectations.internship: Explain fundamentals and trace a failure-safe API operation with guidance; no production ownership is assumed.
experience_expectations.fresher: Build or explain a failure-safe API operation in a project, including basic tests and limitations.
experience_expectations.intermediate: Debug a failure-safe API operation under realistic constraints and compare practical alternatives using evidence.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about architecture, reliability, security and operational trade-offs around a failure-safe API operation; document assumptions and failure recovery.

roles.name: full stack developer

experience_expectations.internship: Explain fundamentals and trace a browser-to-database feature with guidance; no production ownership is assumed.

experience_expectations.intermediate: Debug a browser-to-database feature under realistic constraints and compare practical alternatives using evidence.
experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about architecture, reliability, security and operational trade-offs around a browser-to-database feature; document assumptions and failure recovery.

roles.rationale: An initial DevOps/cloud operating baseline; no particular cloud vendor or senior cluster design is required by default.

experience_expectations.experienced: Reason about architecture, reliability, security and operational trade-offs around a deterministic boundary-case test; document assumptions and failure recovery.
